# Rider-Waite-Smith card images

The 78 card images in this directory are localized copies of the 350x600 scans
published in `metabismuth/tarot-json`, pinned to commit
`e6414a098acc87831a8953bca7576b033b2fda54`. That dataset traces the scans to
`data.totl.net/tarot-rwcs-images/`.

They depict the 1909 Rider-Waite-Smith deck illustrated by Pamela Colman Smith.
The exact source URL, byte size, and SHA-256 digest for every copied file are
recorded in `../asset-manifest.json` so the local asset set can be audited and
reproduced with `node scripts/localize-assets.mjs`. The original 1909 artwork is
public domain; the dataset repository itself is MIT licensed.

Do not replace these files with images from a modern commercial deck unless the
project has explicit redistribution rights for that deck.
